taxonomy.label: Textureless Surface
taxonomy.desc: Featureless planar walls, doors, ceilings with low gradient variance. Self-attention patches lack contrast gradients, defaulting to an ambiguous flat depth prior.
taxonomy.remedy: Enforce normal-guided planar consistency loss and CutBlur synthetic frequency noise augmentation.

taxonomy.label: Boundary Mixing / Bleed
taxonomy.desc: Depth bleeding across high-frequency foreground/background object contours. The 14x14 ViT patch blends near and far depth into a single spatial token.
taxonomy.remedy: Apply boundary-localized bilateral smoothing and edge-aware cross-attention filtering.

taxonomy.label: Occlusion Boundary
taxonomy.desc: Sharp depth step discontinuities behind occluding foreground geometry where visibility is partially masked.
taxonomy.remedy: Incorporate multi-view temporal consensus or depth-discontinuity ranking loss.

taxonomy.label: Specular Reflection
taxonomy.desc: Non-Lambertian glares, mirrors, or glossy floor reflections violating the diffuse surface assumption.
taxonomy.remedy: Supervise with surface normal consistency and polarization cues to discard specular false virtual depths.

taxonomy.label: Thin Slender Structure
taxonomy.desc: Elongated geometries (chair legs, cords, poles) smaller than the ViT 14x14 receptive field, causing loss of detection.
taxonomy.remedy: Deploy high-resolution multi-scale feature pyamids with dilated convolutions in the decoder.

taxonomy.label: Poor / Extreme Lighting
taxonomy.desc: Extreme underexposed shadow regions or overexposed glares depressing the visual signal-to-noise ratio.
taxonomy.remedy: Apply high-dynamic-range (HDR) gamma exposure augmentation during model fine-tuning.

taxonomy.label: Ambiguous / Multi-Factor
taxonomy.desc: Weak overall signal or competing hypotheses where multiple visual and architectural factors contribute equally.
taxonomy.remedy: Perform controlled active sensor ablation to decouple lighting from surface texture effects.
